SELECT id, task_id, subject_id, unit_id, record_date, amount, duration_minutes, content, note, client_token, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM study_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, task_id, subject_id, unit_id, record_date, amount, duration_minutes, content, note, client_token, version, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM study_record WHERE client_token = #{clientToken} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_record (task_id, subject_id, unit_id, record_date, amount, duration_minutes, content, note, client_token, version) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{subjectId}, #{unitId}, #{recordDate}, #{amount}, #{durationMinutes}, #{content}, #{note}, #{clientToken}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE study_record SET task_id = #{taskId}, subject_id = #{subjectId}, unit_id = #{unitId}, record_date = #{recordDate}, amount = #{amount}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, content = #{content}, note = #{note}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE study_record SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
